# //go:embedbuild embeds a build of another package for another target.
[short] skip 'builds a js/wasm binary'

go build -o main$GOEXE .
exec ./main$GOEXE
stdout '^blob/README$'
stdout '^blob/app.wasm.gz$'
stdout '^module magic 0061736d$'

# The inner build is not cached as a file, but equal inputs give equal bytes.
go build -o main2$GOEXE .
cmp main$GOEXE main2$GOEXE

# go install pkg@version builds the embedded package at the same version.
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw
go install -n example.com/embedbuild@v1.0.0
stderr 'go install example.com/embedbuild/wasm@v1.0.0'
go install example.com/embedbuild@v1.0.0
exec $GOPATH/bin/embedbuild$GOEXE
stdout '^blob/app.wasm.gz$'
env GOFLAGS=

# A package that embeds a build of itself for the same target is an error.
! go build -o self.out ./self
stderr 'go:embedbuild cycle: example.com/eb/self GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm'

# The name must fall under a //go:embed pattern.
! go build -o bad.out ./bad
stderr 'nothere/x is not under any //go:embed pattern'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/eb

go 1.27
-- blob/README --
committed
-- wasm/main.go --
package main

func main() { println("wasm") }
-- main.go --
//go:embedbuild -gzip blob/app.wasm.gz GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

import (
	"compress/gzip"
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
)

//go:embed blob
var blob embed.FS

func main() {
	fs.WalkDir(blob, "blob", func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if !d.IsDir() {
			fmt.Println(p)
		}
		return nil
	})
	f, err := blob.Open("blob/app.wasm.gz")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	zr, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	b, err := io.ReadAll(zr)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("module magic %x\n", b[:4])
}
-- self/self.bin --
-- self/main.go --
//go:embedbuild self.bin GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/self

package main

import _ "embed"

//go:embed self.bin
var b []byte

func main() { println(len(b)) }
-- bad/main.go --
//go:embedbuild nothere/x GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm example.com/eb/wasm

package main

func main() {}
